Yellow Change Intervals would avoid about 1.2 crashes a year (CMF 4219, the more conservative of the two middle records of 4; evidence: only if a site check confirms it), worth $401,000 a year; check on site: an entry on yellow or red; the current yellow plus all-red time is below the ITE recommended practice.
